<module id="calendar">
    <description>Perpetual Calendar</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="CLK">Clock input.</input>
        <input id="RST">Active high reset signal.</input>
        <output id="Hours" width_description="[5:0]">6-bit output representing the current hours.</output>
        <output id="Mins" width_description="[5:0]">6-bit output representing the current minutes.</output>
        <output id="Secs" width_description="[5:0]">6-bit output representing the current seconds.</output>
    </ports>
    <implementation>Three always blocks are used to update the values of seconds, minutes, and hours based on the clock signal and reset signal.</implementation>
    
    <task id="update_secs">
        <description>Update seconds value based on clock signal and reset signal.</description>
        <input id="CLK">Clock input.</input>
        <input id="RST">Active high reset signal.</input>
        <output id="Secs" width_description="[5:0]">6-bit output representing the current seconds.</output>
        
        <implementation>
            // Update seconds value based on clock signal and reset signal
            always @(posedge CLK or posedge RST) begin
                if (RST) begin
                    Secs <= 6'd0;
                end else if (Secs == 6'd59) begin
                    Secs <= 6'd0;
                end else begin
                    Secs <= Secs + 6'd1;
                end
            end
        </implementation>
    </task>
    
    <task id="update_mins">
        <description>Update minutes value based on clock signal and reset signal.</description>
        <input id="CLK">Clock input.</input>
        <input id="RST">Active high reset signal.</input>
        <output id="Mins" width_description="[5:0]">6-bit output representing the current minutes.</output>
        
        <implementation>
            // Update minutes value based on clock signal and reset signal
            always @(posedge CLK or posedge RST) begin
                if (RST) begin
                    Mins <= 6'd0;
                end else if (Mins == 6'd59 && Secs == 6'd59) begin
                    Mins <= 6'd0;
                end else if (Secs == 6'd59) begin
                    Mins <= Mins + 6'd1;
                end else begin
                    Mins <= Mins;
                end
            end
        </implementation>
    </task>
    
    <task id="update_hours">
        <description>Update hours value based on clock signal and reset signal.</description>
        <input id="CLK">Clock input.</input>
        <input id="RST">Active high reset signal.</input>
        <output id="Hours" width_description="[5:0]">6-bit output representing the current hours.</output>
        
        <implementation>
            // Update hours value based on clock signal and reset signal
            always @(posedge CLK or posedge RST) begin
                if (RST) begin
                    Hours <= 6'd0;
                end else if (Hours == 6'd23 && Mins == 6'd59 && Secs == 6'd59) begin
                    Hours <= 6'd0;
                end else if (Mins == 6'd59 && Secs == 6'd59) begin
                    Hours <= Hours + 6'd1;
                end else begin
                    Hours <= Hours;
                end
            end
        </implementation>
    </task>
</module>
